reviews.text: Generally good with pleasant folk. After many visits over 17 months inconsistency is a feature, not an aberration. Can be mediocre. Seems to be no check on whether what was asked for (ie 'let's do as per last visit, as recorded, 1 blade shorter for the hot weather) is communicated fully between front office and groomers, and definitely no check before handing dog over post service. Groomers themselves are faulted.
Best daycare facility in Studio City
This is a one-stop shop for your beloved pup.
They do a great job every time.
Thanks for taking care of my pups!

I am a new customer. A great spitz that loves a lion cut. Everyone was very helpful, and called as I forgot to tell them to keep the full tail. Will definitely come back. Super clean and everyone is on their A-Game
Absolutely love this place to bits. Staff is amazing my dog loves daycare he’s so happy when during pick up and drop off. The pick up times are great and flexible and the grooming is superb.

Ishmael has been our dog groomer at Sam’s for over 5 years and Delilah comes back looking fresh with a pep in her step. So grateful for the great care she receives

I am so grateful to the staff at Sam’s for how well they take care of my dog Shug at daycare and boarding. While we were out of town, she was a little under the weather, and they provided daily updates and followed up when we got home to make sure she was okay (she’s just fine). It’s a wonderful feeling to drop your dog off somewhere where she is loved and protected. Thank you, Sam’s!
We bring my dog and my MILs dog, we think they are great!

Best groomer’s I’ve ever taken my dog to. They have great availability, reasonable prices, are always nice, and my dog always comes out happy and super well groomed. So happy to have them in the neighborhood!
I really like this place and the staff. They are always very nice and take care very well of my dog.

Always enjoy taking my shih tzu Jojo to Sam’s for grooming. I’ve been taking her for the past several months after getting a recommendation from a friend and every experience has been a great one. It’s very easy to make an appointment online, pricing is very reasonable, they take great care of my dog, and she comes out looking adorable and excited every time. I also just really appreciate the team here and their friendliness. Thank you to everyone at Sams Green Paw. 🐾
Sam's is our go to for boarding. Our Cavapoo loves Sam's. He gets so excited when he knows we are going there that it's actually a little sad he seems so happy to go.
